channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: 3 in 4 Republicans under 45 say they prefer US funded health care over Israel aid
item.description: New IMEU and YouGov polling shows majorities of Republican voters, especially younger adults, favor redirecting taxpayer dollars from Israel to domestic health care as skepticism grows over long-term military funding.

item.title: Holiday shoppers are flexing political power through big boycott campaigns
item.description: Genocide in Gaza, raids on immigrants and attacks on DEI have spurred urgent calls to boycott companies like Home Depot, Target, Chevron and Microsoft.

item.title: House moderates move to force vote as ACA tax credits near expiration
item.description: Four Republicans join Democrats in discharge petition amid looming premium hikes for millions.

item.title: Senate approves record Pentagon budget as Democrats help advance Trump’s defense agenda
item.description: Bipartisan vote sends $900 billion military bill to Trump’s desk amid war powers concerns and domestic cuts.
